subject.title: fix: clean up queued chat turns on abort

question: Should maintainers land this guarded PR as the canonical queued chat-turn abort cleanup fix and retire https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102935?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same leak; this one appears technically stronger, but choosing which contributor branch to merge and how to retire the overlap is a maintainer review action.
